Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
I'm normally on Lackey every other night or so — beginning to become a slight issue with the other half. Typically there will be enough players for 1 - 2 tables in the evening (EU time).

The games take longer than in real life, however with Skype they work really well and online, are as close as your going to get to sitting at a table with a pint in your hand...

There's a Skype VTES group conversion used to organise Skype + Lackey Games — pm me your Skype usernames and I'll add you to the conversation if you're interested.

Ke
